    w = observation.get("grid_width", 0)
    h = observation.get("grid_height", 0)
    me = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    op = observation.get("opponent_position", None)
    res = observation.get("resources", []) or []
    obs = set(tuple(p) for p in (observation.get("obstacles", []) or []))
    sp = set(tuple(p) for p in (observation.get("self_path", []) or []))
    op_path = set(tuple(p) for p in (observation.get("opponent_path", []) or []))
    mx, my = int(me[0]), int(me[1])
    ox, oy = (int(op[0]), int(op[1])) if isinstance(op, (list, tuple)) and len(op) >= 2 else (None, None)

    best = (0, 0)
    best_score = -10**9
    moves = [(0, 0), (1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)]

        nx, ny = mx + dx, my + dy
        if w and (nx < 0 or nx >= w) or h and (ny < 0 or ny >= h):
            continue
        if (nx, ny) in obs:
            continue
        score = 0
        if (nx, ny) in sp:
            score -= 2
        if (nx, ny) in op_path:
            score -= 1
        if ox is not None:
            d = abs(nx - ox) + abs(ny - oy)
            score += 2 if d <= 1 else 0
        if res:
            dmin = min(abs(nx - int(r[0])) + abs(ny - int(r[1])) for r in res if isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) and len(r) >= 2)
            score -= dmin * 3
            if (nx, ny) in [tuple(r) for r in res if isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) and len(r) >= 2]:
                score += 50
        score -= abs(dx) + abs(dy)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best = (dx, dy)

    return [int(best[0]), int(best[1])]
